codes.message: The project's sources did not compile: {detail}
codes.fix: Correct the source at the reported file and line; the detail carries the authoring compiler's own finding.

codes.message: Cannot format sources; check paths and permissions.
codes.fix: Check that the named source paths exist and are readable and writable, then format again.

codes.message: Unknown formatter option; use norn fmt [path...] [--check] [--json].
codes.fix: Run norn fmt [path...] with only --check or --json as options.

codes.message: Target is not an empty directory; choose a new directory.
codes.fix: Choose a new or empty target directory for norn init.

codes.message: Dependency installation failed; retry bun install in the project directory.
codes.fix: Run bun install in the project directory, or rerun norn init with --no-install and install later.

codes.message: Invalid norn.json; use norn-project/1 with explicit sources, scope, dev and cell, and remove unknown keys.
codes.fix: Use norn-project/1 in norn.json with explicit sources, scope, dev and cell, and remove unknown keys.

codes.message: Invalid namespace; use a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
codes.fix: Use a namespace that starts with a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or underscores.

codes.message: Cannot write project; check directory permissions.
codes.fix: Check write permissions for the target directory and run norn init again.

codes.message: No norn.json found; run norn init <dir> first.
codes.fix: Run norn init <dir> first, or run the command from a directory containing norn.json.

codes.message: Usage: norn init <dir> [--namespace NS] [--org ID] [--env ID] [--template starter|empty] [--no-install] [--json]
codes.fix: Run norn init <dir> with only the documented options.

codes.message: The checker WASM package is unavailable; build it and set NORN_CHECKER_WASM_PKG.
codes.fix: Build the checker package with crates/norn-checker-wasm/scripts/build-pkg.sh and set NORN_CHECKER_WASM_PKG to its directory.

codes.message: No native Norn host; build it with `cargo build -p norn-cell-do --bin norn-dev-host` and set NORN_DEV_HOST_BIN to target/debug/norn-dev-host.
codes.fix: Build the native host with cargo build -p norn-cell-do --bin norn-dev-host and set NORN_DEV_HOST_BIN to target/debug/norn-dev-host.

codes.message: Published distribution is unavailable; run init from the repository.
codes.fix: Run norn init from a repository checkout until a published distribution is available.
